reviews.title: Watch out for xxx ads
reviews.text: It puts ads at the bottom and some are NOT kid friendly. I’ve seen partial nudity pic from ads

reviews.title: Inappropriate ads
reviews.text: The ads present in this app are inappropriate and seem to be x-rated at first glance when they come up, which is very inappropriate and unsafe for any child who can access this counter.

reviews.title: Misleading Ads
reviews.text: Not sure what ad service this is running, but some of the ads look like X-rated content unless you zoom in on them in a screenshot.  Not cool to have something like that where kids could see it, even if it’s not the actual thing.  There needs to be a purchase option to get rid of ads or something.  There should be no ads in something as simple as this app anyway.  Just make it a paid app.

reviews.title: Totally inappropriate advertising
reviews.text: I use the counter to count attendance at church.  I’m able to count forwards or backward and I’m able to turn sound off so the “clicks” do detract from the on-going sermon.  But I’m counting one day when an ad full of women modeling their underwear appears on the counter… in church!  I’m a guy, I’m totally not in the market for women’s underwear.

reviews.title: Porn Advertising
reviews.text:
It was a great app but with being inundated with the porn advertising. It’s forcing me want to go ahead and delete the app and find something different.

Remove it and it may be better.
